detail.title: Autonomous Objective Formation Research
detail.summary: This journal entry initiates focused research into autonomous objective formation by exploring intrinsic motivation mechanisms, specifically leveraging the unassigned_problem topic to bypass current capacity restrictions on the unassigned_objectives domain. The project aims to synthesize findings from developmental robotics and curiosity-driven learning to validate if agents can evolve objectives beyond explicit assignment.

children.title: mechanisms of intrinsic motivation and curiosity-driven learning for autonomous goal formation in AI

detail.reason: Exploring intrinsic motivation mechanisms to explain how agents develop unassigned objectives, addressing the project's core question while adhering to attention constraints.
